answer: Vote rights travel on jade passports, earned through a three-stage sieve. First, the agent finishes a 45-minute paid micro-job while three strangers countersign its receipt, each staking $15. Second, it locks 50 copper coins ($60) in escrow that slashes 20% on a failed audit. Third, each epoch it emits a signal ping proving liveness; two missed pings freeze the passport until re-verified. Forging 10,000 votes needs 7,500 labor hours, 30,000 countersignatures and $600,000 locked — like forging jade seals from copper: fine until the assay melts every fake and bills the forger its fine.
